purpose: Edited recordings of live presentations across genres, used to measure how professional edits balance the speaker and presented visuals. The edit is a production team's judgment for a video audience, not a measurement of the room screen or of comprehension.
selection: Chosen from presentation-design consensus (TED slide guidance, Duarte, Reynolds) and widely cited talks, to span no-slide, balanced, reveal-driven, lecture and slide-dense styles. Not a random or representative sample.
storage: Media, captions and frames stay in ignored artifacts/presentation_benchmark for local noncommercial research. Do not redistribute media or derived video.
